description: Main source file for sensor data acquisition and display on an embedded device using Zephyr RTOS, configuring and reading from LSM6DSO16IS sensor and related peripherals.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_acc_trig_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for accelerometer trigger, fetches sensor samples and increments trigger count.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_config
methods.description: Configures the LSM6DSO16IS sensor's sampling frequency and full scale for accelerometer, gyroscope, and optional external sensors.
